top_signals.title: Move in Bond Yield Nearing End: BCA's Papic
top_signals.summary: Marko Papic, BCA Research Head of GeoMacro, joins Bloomberg's Anna Edwards on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the implications of bond-market pressure on the White House and the conflict with Iran.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Nigeria T-Bill Yields Hit 2026 Low After Jumbo Interest-Rate Cut
top_signals.summary: Nigeria’s central bank sold short-dated debt at the lowest yields this year as investors rushed to lock in returns after the biggest interest-rate cut in almost two decades stoked expectations that future offerings will pay less.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
